value: At Light's Hammer, Highlord Darion Mograine sets a perilous undertaking before the champions who might bear it. Death Knights, Paladins and Warriors may take up the work; no one class alone owns its history. From the remnants of Arthas's discarded hammer and powers bound to Icecrown, Darion seeks an axe that might stand against Frostmourne. He warns that the attempt may undo the one who bears it. A doubt hangs over the proposal: to answer a devouring blade by making another.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
